notes_for_editor: Very thin evidence. The only dated item is the 1911 State Board of Forestry report (for 1910-11) as quoted on the Forest Lookouts Roth Rock page; that quote names Table Rock on Backbone Mountain, not Roth Rock, and no source read links the two, so it is not recorded as an event. Two WebSearch queries and roughly three page reads were used. The Maryland DNR Fire Tower Report (dnr.maryland.gov/forests/documents/fire/Fire_Tower_Report.pdf) covers surviving DNR towers and does not mention Roth Rock. Wikipedia's Backbone Mountain article describes a West Virginia tower at the mountain's southern end and does not name Roth Rock. Needed: a Maryland Forest Service, Garrett County or NRHP/MIHP source giving the tower's build date, staffing, removal and what the site is like now. No access or visit facts are supported.
